_about: Mabeyn->Yemen system B, two-digit numerals -> Ottoman letter. Built ONLY from the clerk's glosses on training sheets HPBK 541 and 585 (passes A+B, arbitrated). Bare ticks (ـ) are not glosses. Arbitrations: 27 glossed as a he-like curl = final nun (contexts یاوران, شهریاریدن, تلغرافنامه on 541); 28 angle gloss = initial mim (قایممقام, نامه); 41 gloss read ل/ن (4/4), the dot inside -> ن; 42 loop with one dot = ف/ق (same skeleton); 51 gloss 'سه' = initial س/ش (شهریاری); 55 short stroke = ر.
